papers.title: Stable intuition and the rise of deliberative prosociality in childhood.
papers.abstract: We examine how social behaviours emerge and stabilize across childhood. A sample of 537 Italian-speaking children (3-10 years) were randomly assigned to respond under time pressure (intuitive) or time delay (deliberative) in social decision tasks (Public Goods, Dictator, Ultimatum, Deception and Moral Dilemmas). Factor analysis identified three latent dimensions: Prosociality (cooperative, altruistic and honest actions), Social Optimism (beliefs about others' cooperation) and Acquiescence (tendency to accept offers). Intuitive responses were more prosocial than deliberative ones in early childhood (β = 0.66; 95% CI = (0.35, 0.97)), but this difference diminished with age (β = -0.11; 95% CI = (-0.18, -0.05)). We found no evidence that Social Optimism varied across age or decision mode, whereas Acquiescence declined with age (β = -0.14; 95% CI = (-0.19, -0.10)). These findings suggest a developmental shift whereby prosocial behaviour is initially driven by intuitive responses and gradually becomes embedded within reflective, deliberative decision-making systems, as cooperative dispositions stabilize across childhood.
papers.summary: 本研究針對537名3至10歲的義大利語兒童進行實驗，探討兒童時期社會行為的發展與穩定機制。透過公共物品、獨裁者等社會決策任務，比較直覺反應與深思熟慮反應的差異。因子分析得出親社會性、社會樂觀主義與順從性三個潛在維度。結果顯示，兒童早期的親社會行為主要由直覺驅動，但隨著年齡增長，直覺與深思熟慮的差異逐漸消失，表明親社會傾向會從直覺反應逐漸轉變為深思熟慮的決策系統；此外，社會樂觀主義保持穩定，而順從性則隨年齡下降。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了人類親社會行為在童年期的發展軌跡，挑戰了單一認知系統的解釋框架。它證明了合作傾向隨著年齡增長而趨於穩定，且決策模式會發生從「直覺親社會」到「深思熟慮親社會」的動態轉變。這對於理解人類道德與合作行為的演化基礎，以及成年人在經濟與社會決策中的雙重認知歷程，提供了關鍵的發展心理學證據。

papers.title: Bridging the divide in motor learning research.
papers.abstract: Motor learning underlies our ability to acquire and perfect movements across all domains of human behaviour. Its study encompasses two distinct but related endeavours: basic research on how we learn movement skills and applied research on how to enhance skill acquisition in real-world contexts. Despite their natural complementarity, these approaches developed historically in two largely independent communities with different disciplinary roots. One is closely associated with computational neuroscience and focuses predominantly on basic research. The other comes from experimental psychology and movement sciences with a stronger focus on applied research. The division between these communities is reflected in the experimental tasks they use, the theoretical frameworks they develop and the cultural norms that shape their training and communication. In this Perspective, we scrutinize this divide, review emerging efforts towards better integration and identify future opportunities. We contend that bridging these gaps can build a more comprehensive science of motor learning.
papers.summary: 運動學習研究長期以來分為兩個相對獨立的領域：一是源自計算神經科學、著重於基礎研究；二是來自實驗心理學與運動科學、偏重於應用研究。本文探討了這兩個社群在實驗任務、理論框架及學術文化上的分歧，並回顧了近期促進兩者整合的努力，為未來建立更全面的運動學習科學提供方向。
papers.significance: 跨越基礎與應用運動學習研究之間的鴻溝，不僅能打破學科壁壘，還能促進理論與實踐的雙向交流。這種整合將有助於發展更具解釋力與實用性的統一理論框架，從而推動運動學習科學的全面發展，並改善真實世界中的技能學習與復健策略。

papers.title: Dissociable individuals' neural responses to morality and competence evaluations during the anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.abstract: Previous studies have shown that individuals assign differential weight to morality versus competence during feedback processing. However, these studies failed to disentangle the anticipatory and consummatory stages from feedback processing. Therefore, using event-related potentials, the current study adapted an effort-based prosocial task to explore individuals' neural response to morality and competence evaluations in both the anticipatory and consummatory stages. Behaviorally, an interaction effect between evaluation valence and evaluation dimension showed that competence evaluations were rated as more negative than morality evaluations when evaluations were negative, while competence evaluations were rated as more arousing than morality evaluations when evaluations were positive. The ERP results revealed that, during the anticipatory stage, the Cue-P3 was larger when participants received competence cues relative to morality cues in positive contexts. Conversely, the SPN was larger after receiving morality cues compared to competence cues in positive contexts. In the consummatory stages, the LPP was larger for morality evaluations compared to competence evaluations, regardless of positive or negative evaluations. In conclusion, these results provide evidence for a dissociable effect between morality and competence evaluations during both anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.summary: 本研究透過事件相關電位技術與基於努力的親社會任務，探討個體在預期與消費階段對道德及能力評估的神經反應。行為數據顯示，負面評估中能力評價比道德評價更負面，而正面評估中能力評價則更具喚醒度。腦電波結果表明，在預期階段，正面向情境下能力線索引發較大的Cue-P3，道德線索則引發較大的SPN；在消費階段，無論正負面，道德評估皆引發較大的LPP。此結果證實了道德與能力評估在兩個階段中具有可分離的神經機制。
papers.significance: 該研究填補了過去文獻未能區分反饋處理中預期與消費階段的空白，首次從神經層面提供道德與能力評估在兩個階段具有可分離效應的實證證據。此發現不僅深化了對人類社會認知雙維度處理機制的理解，也為未來探討社會評價的動態腦神經動力學提供了重要基礎。
